compilerOptions.//paths: Mirrors the alias in vitest.config.ts. Files under tests/ are not members of any workspace package, so without this the linter sees @ictt-sentinel/* as `any` and every type-aware rule goes quiet. Build resolution is unaffected: tsconfig.build.json uses project references.

//include: `.tsx` and the console's e2e and build configs are here too: a file the linter cannot see is a file its type-aware rules stay silent about, which is the quiet way a gate stops gating.
